coordinate_frame.name: current_target_local_rhs
coordinate_frame.x_axis: target forward direction at prediction time
coordinate_frame.y_axis: target left direction at prediction time
coordinate_frame.transform_rule: all historical positions and velocities are transformed using the current target pose

mask_semantics.1: ego and target states are both available and time-aligned within 0.1 s
mask_semantics.0: missing token; feature values are zero-filled and must be ignored by masked layers

token_features.name: time_offset_s
token_features.definition: token timestamp relative to the prediction time

token_features.name: ego_rel_x_m
token_features.definition: ego position minus current target position in the current target-local longitudinal axis

token_features.name: ego_rel_y_m
token_features.definition: ego position minus current target position in the current target-local lateral axis

token_features.name: target_rel_x_m
token_features.definition: historical target position minus current target position in the current target-local longitudinal axis

token_features.name: target_rel_y_m
token_features.definition: historical target position minus current target position in the current target-local lateral axis

token_features.name: relative_longitudinal_speed_mps
token_features.definition: ego velocity minus target velocity projected onto the current target-local longitudinal axis

token_features.name: relative_lateral_speed_mps
token_features.definition: ego velocity minus target velocity projected onto the current target-local lateral axis

token_features.name: sin_relative_yaw
token_features.definition: sine of ego yaw minus target yaw

token_features.name: cos_relative_yaw
token_features.definition: cosine of ego yaw minus target yaw

normalization.fit_on: train split only (init 01-40 across all four cells)

online_offline_contract: Day 4 must call one shared feature builder for logged samples and online inference; an equivalence test is required before formal collection.
